title: JellyLoop Works
text:
JellyLoop Works

Lead source: self-serve signup -> trial used hosted API keys; inbound from game dev forum. Founder (CTO) Samir on call 2026-02-27: 'need chat that's fast and doesn't explode the bill during events.'

Summary:
- Small indie studio building a social mobile game (4v4 casual matches + persistent lobbies).
- Primary ask: reliable low-latency chat for in-match comms and lobby chat; continuous short messages, typing-like traffic.
- Secondary: automated moderation (spam/abuse), player onboarding prompts, lightweight in-game assistant (help tips).

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Latency target: median RTT <= 60ms for text generation in NA; p95 ideally < 120ms.
- Throughput: expect spikes to ~800 concurrent chat sessions during launch events, average 150-200 active.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget, want guidance on batching/caching to reduce token spend.
- Model preference: open to small/quantized LLMs; prefer quick warmup and KV caching.
- Routing/fallback: prefer hosted only (initial), may later consider Dedicated if SLA needed.
- Security: basic audit logs, retention settings. No enterprise SSO required now.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-02-12: Self-serve signup, redeemed trial credits (hosted API).
- 2026-02-17: Initial integration attempt by dev lead; observed inconsistent p99 latency in stress test. (notes in /drive).
- 2026-02-23: AE outreach (Avery) - Discovery call scheduled.
- 2026-02-27: Discovery call + Fireflies recorded (ff_001245890). Discussed use-case and cost sensitivity.
- 2026-03-01: Devs ran small POC using streaming endpoint; flagged moderation false positives.
- 2026-03-05: Follow-up email with sample pricing scenarios and recommended batching settings.

POC plan (proposed):
- Short POC (2 weeks): integrate hosted API streaming for lobby + match chat (limited to 2 regions).
- Add moderation webhook to filter toxic content, measure false positive/negative rates on 1k messages sample.
- Load test simulating 1k simultaneous users using our suggested batching + prefix caching.
- Deliverable: latency report (median/p95), cost projection, moderation accuracy summary.

Notes from engineers / quotes:
- Dev lead: 'We need chat to feel instant. If generation takes >100ms perceptibly it's bad.'
- Product: wants a fallback policy to fallback to smaller model when capacity strained.

Next steps (AE/SE):
- Send short proof-of-action doc and pre-configured API keys (Avery).
- SE Diego to run quick benchmark recipe and share kernel/latency tuning tips (Diego).
- Arrange 30m technical sync to walk through moderation tuning, streaming best practices.

Blockers / Risks:
- Concern about token cost for continuous short messages — wants real examples from other small games.
- Need clear SLA/p95 guidance — might ask about Dedicated if spikes can't be smoothed.
- Moderation edge cases in non-English chat (Spanish/Portuguese) — wants example coverage.

CRM flavour notes (short):
- Friendly, pragmatic team. CTO hands-on.
- Momentum: trial usage + follow-ups -> good early signal.
- Quote: 'If the hosted plan gives predictable bills and low latency, we'll convert quickly.'

Linked artifacts:
- Fireflies: ff_001245890 (2026-02-27 discovery)
- Drive: /drive/pricing/jellyloop-pricing-compare-2026.pdf (initial ask), /drive/security/jellyloop-security-questions-2026.md
- Jira escalations: INF-2345 (reported noisy moderation on POC)

Owner notes (Avery): keep POC lean. emphasize batching + prefix caching in recommendations. Push cost example for 10k messages/day and for peak 1k concurrent.
